# Error #86: TooManyRateSegments

## Summary
- **Numeric Code**: `#86`
- **Variant Name**: `TooManyRateSegments`
- **Status**: Active (Enforced)
- **Client Toast Level**: `ERROR`
- **Retryable**: `No`

---

## Trigger Conditions
The contract rejects the call when any of these registry conditions holds:
- `Branch::RateSegmentLimitReached` — the stream already carries MAX_RATE_SEGMENTS rate-change segments.

---

## Minimal Reproduction

Focused regression test: [`contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::rate_segment_limit_is_enforced`](../../contracts/streaming-payments/src/test.rs::rate_segment_limit_is_enforced). The matrix arm below is the smallest direct construction; `rejected!` records the fired branch and asserts its mapped code.

```rust
// RateSegmentLimitReached — excerpt from error_surface_test.rs
let f = Fixture::setup_quiet();
let id = f.create_stream(DEPOSIT, 0, 10 * DAY, false);
// One accepted change adds one window; the cap refuses the next.
fill_rate_segments(&f, id, MAX_RATE_SEGMENTS - 1);
f.advance_time(1);
f.client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .propose_rate_change(&f.sender, &id, &RATE_PER_SECOND);
Some(rejected!(f
    .client
    .mock_all_auths()
    .try_accept_rate_change(&f.recipient, &id)))
```

Run the focused test:

```bash
cargo test -p streampay-contract --locked rate_segment_limit_is_enforced
```

---

## User Remediation Guidance
> **Plain-Language Remediation**:  
> Do not exceed `MAX_RATE_SEGMENTS` renegotiations on one stream; create a new stream for further rate changes.
>
> **Reference**: [`docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#31-piecewise-rates-a-stream-that-renegotiated-issue-54`](../../docs/ARCHITECTURE.md#31-piecewise-rates-a-stream-that-renegotiated-issue-54)
